title: Vector databases in 60 seconds
caption: Vector databases in 60 seconds: searching by meaning instead of matching words. #ai #vectordatabase #search

scenes.title: Vector databases
scenes.say: How does search find cheap flights when you typed budget travel?
scenes.sub: How does search find cheap flights when you typed budget travel?

scenes.say: A normal search matches words. Search for car, and you miss the page that only says vehicle.
A vector database searches by meaning.

items.title: Embed
items.text: text becomes a list of numbers
items.say: First, a model turns every piece of text into a list of numbers.

items.title: Store
items.say: Text with similar meaning lands close together.

items.title: Query
items.say: Then a query finds the nearest points.

scenes.code:
results = db.query(
  embed("cheap cars"),
  top_k=3
)
# → "affordable vehicles"
#   "budget used autos"
scenes.say: Search cheap cars, and you get affordable vehicles, even with no words in common.
That's a vector database. Search by meaning, not by spelling.
